# KITTY CORP

> Independent Technology Company & AI Studio based in India.
> Official Website: https://thekittycorp.com

KITTY CORP builds modern business websites, custom software, and practical AI workflow automation, while conducting early-stage laboratory research into robotics and intelligent autonomous systems.

## Divisions

### 01 Digital Solutions
- **Websites**: Custom high-performance business websites, marketing hubs, and admissions platforms.
- **Apps & Software**: Client-facing software, mobile-first architectures, and custom database backends.
- **AI & Automation**: Practical AI workflows, intelligent companion agents, and task orchestration where humans remain in control.
- **Flagship Subscription — KITTY One ($199 USD)**: All-access enterprise membership bundling 1 premium custom website, 1 basic responsive website, KITTY AI product suite access, all future upgrades, and 6 months of direct technical maintenance. URL: https://thekittycorp.com/memberships

### 02 Intelligence & Robotics (Lab Research)
- **AGRIYAAN**: Autonomous agricultural rover exploration for field optimization and crop monitoring.
- **URJAYAAN**: Intelligent controls and monitoring software for solar generation and clean energy storage.
- **KITTY BUDDY**: Companion robotics concept for everyday household assistance and personal interactions.

## Shipped Products & Live Work
- **EXAMIFY** (https://examify.thekittycorp.com): Exam countdown, focus blocks, and study tools for competitive admissions.
- **KITTY AI** (Android v2.0.0): On-device conversational AI companion.
- **SecretChat** (Android v2.0.0): Private encrypted real-time messaging application.

## Technical Stack
- Next.js (App Router, Turbopack, React 19)
- WebGL2 physical simulation rendering engine (off-thread worker, KHR_parallel_shader_compile)
- Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification
- Razorpay, UPI, and international payment clearing
- Supabase enterprise database backend
- Content Security Policy (CSP) & strict HSTS preloading
